purposeText: V2 Flashcard is built for teachers to help students memorize vocabulary, meanings, and definitions across languages. Create decks, run study sessions, and run timed tests to support classroom practice and retention.
creditText: This app is made by Vito.
step1: Create or edit a deck — open the editor to add a deck and create cards. Put the word or phrase on one side and the meaning or definition on the other.
createDeckSteps: Open the editor, click Add Deck, give the deck a name, then add cards. For each card put the term on the front and the definition on the back. Save when finished.
step2: Select a deck — choose a deck from the left list to open the study view and begin reviewing cards.
step3: Study — flip cards, mark answers, and use the encouragement and combo feedback to motivate learners.
prepareTestSteps: In Study view enable Test Mode, click Prepare Test, enter the student or team name, set per-card time and number of cards, then click Test Start to begin the timed test.
step4: Use Test Mode — enable Test Mode in the study view to reveal the test controls row. Click Prepare Test, enter the student or team name, set per-card time, then click Test Start to run a timed test.
step5: Save and resume — sessions persist locally so you can pause and continue later.
note1: The Clear all local data action is destructive and requires typing "clear all" to confirm.
note2: Some features such as the Report view are placeholders and will be improved in future updates.
plannedText: Reports and analytics will be expanded in later releases to provide better classroom insights and export options.
